description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. Download certificate PDF. Files: the document the institution issued, unchanged, as PDF, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm_download.description: Default false. Set true together with dry_run=false to receive the actual PDF; otherwise the call previews only.

cvrc_no.description: Receipt number (접수번호) selecting which certificate application to act on.

download_all_available.description: Default false. When true, acts on all printable applications instead of a single cvrc_no.

dry_run.description: Default true (preview): returns the receipt number, status and dates only. Set false together with confirm_download=true to receive the actual PDF in the result artifacts.
